description.value: Winners Edge is a local sporting goods and outdoor store serving Lillooet, BC, a small town on the Fraser River that sits at the confluence of several long-distance cycling routes including the Gold Rush Trail. As the only sporting goods store in a remote community with limited services, it may be a useful stop for touring cyclists passing through in need of general outdoor supplies.
